description: Real (not synthetic) CFM decode_ratio on NCI-60 9-cell + DrugOOD native SMILES, RDKit-strict.
honest_framing: PARTIAL: real 0.9939 < synthetic 1.000 (expected — synthetic is upper bound; real < synthetic is the honest framing per party-twenty-spirit §3.5)
notes: Synthetic baseline = 1.000 (Wf-124 ship on Pt-click clouds). Real CFM may be lower; this measurement is the honest gap.

coverage_note.what_actually_ran: Only the PlatinAI-Pt arm. n_sampled 818 drawn from platinai_5k_pt (n_total_platinai 5000, n_pt_subset 874). The NCI-60 and DrugOOD arms did NOT run: n_nci60_loaded 0, n_drugood_loaded 0, both paths null. The scope string says 'on real ligands' without that qualification, which overstates the coverage.
coverage_note.what_the_value_counts: aggregate_n_ok 813 of 818 = 0.9939 is the fraction that RDKit could parse and re-serialise. It is NOT a chemistry metric: no valence, aromaticity, ring or radical check runs here. Same defect as m14 / BLK-C3.
coverage_note.not_a_generation_result: This is decode-from-seeded-geometry (pocket_id 1h36, jitter 0.05, device cpu), not free generation from a noise prior. gen_validity from the free-running CFM runs is 0.23-0.38, roughly 3x lower than the 0.9939 recorded here.
coverage_note.status_qualifier: MEASURED_PASS stands for 'the decode path does not crash and RDKit accepts the output', and nothing stronger. It must not be cited as evidence of generation quality.
